apropos.label: About
apropos.titre: The Full-Figured Woman at the Heart of Development
apropos.texte1: Miss Ronde Cameroun is not only a beauty pageant but, above all, a support programme for full-figured women, working against obesity and encouraging their development.
apropos.texte2: Created in 2012 at the initiative of Mrs Dorette Bouwe Ndjiele, it offers a platform of expression to the full-figured woman. Organised by the Association Femme Ronde Cameroun, under the High Patronage of the Ministry of Arts and Culture, with the support of the Ministry of Tourism and Leisure and the Ministry of Communication.

pageApropos.label: The pageant
pageApropos.chapeau: Miss Ronde Cameroun celebrates the Manga Queen, the full-figured Cameroonian woman. A beauty pageant, and above all a support programme created in 2012.
pageApropos.missionTitre: Change the gaze, open the doors
pageApropos.missionTexte1: Miss Ronde Cameroun is not only a beauty pageant but, above all, a support programme for full-figured women, working against obesity and encouraging their development.
pageApropos.missionTexte2: Created in 2012 at the initiative of Mrs Dorette Bouwe Ndjiele, it offers a platform of expression to the full-figured woman and restores confidence to those too often ignored when female beauty is discussed.
pageApropos.pilier1Texte: Shine a light on the beauty of the full-figured Cameroonian woman, across sizes, complexions and cultures.
pageApropos.pilier2Texte: Support candidates with training in public speaking, entrepreneurship, self-image and leadership.
pageApropos.pilier3Texte: Carry the voice of full-figured women into media, institutions and companies, well beyond the pageant itself.
pageApropos.themeTexte1: The theme of the 11th edition places the full-figured woman at the heart of development. Not only as a celebrated figure, but as an economic and social actor.
pageApropos.themeTexte2: A journey spread across 2026 and 2027: regional finals in four hubs, casting, nutrition day, semi-final on December 28 and 29, 2026, then the election evening on January 30, 2027 at the Palais des Congrès in Yaoundé.
pageApropos.gain4Texte: After the election, the winners become Ambassadors of full-figured women, with support in carrying out their projects.
pageApropos.ctaTitre: Does this adventure sound like yours?
pageApropos.ctaTexte: Applications for the 11th edition are open to Cameroonian full-figured women aged 18 to 40.
pageApropos.mangaTexte1: “Manga Manga” refers to the full-figured woman in the Sudano-Sahelian cultural area of Cameroon. The pageant made it its founding concept.
pageApropos.mangaTexte2: The community of candidates is called the Manga’Queens. Joining it is the first condition to compete.
pageApropos.fondatriceTexte: The pageant was born from her initiative in 2012, with one conviction: the full-figured African woman holds a leading place in education and culture, and she must be seen.
pageApropos.obj1: Involve full-figured women in education actions on solidarity for deprived and vulnerable children, entrepreneurship and empowerment.
pageApropos.obj2: Organise cultural and artistic workshops in shelters for vulnerable children.
pageApropos.obj3: Hold the UNESCO, UN WOMEN and UNFPA conference: “Women, Culture and Child Protection”.
pageApropos.obj4: Work with NGOs to launch social aid projects led by the candidates.
pageApropos.obj5: Fight stereotypes and celebrate body diversity.
pageApropos.obj6: Promote health and the fight against obesity.
pageApropos.obj7: Create professional and entrepreneurial opportunities: training in fashion, nutrition and wellbeing.
pageApropos.galaTexte: A Hollywood-style evening on a T-shaped stage, dress code chic in African attire, before nearly 6,000 spectators at the Palais des Congrès in Yaoundé.
pageApropos.prestationsTexte: Musicians, comedians, a contortionist and a dance group.
pageApropos.distinctionsTexte: The UNESCO “Full-Figured Woman & Child Solidarity” Prize and the Africa Woman Awards.
pageApropos.voteTexte: The final score combines three components, with a decisive weight given to the public.
pageApropos.voteCanaux: The public vote is multi-channel: web, WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram and Instagram. A voting ticket costs 1,000 FCFA. Each candidate thus gathers financial and media support for her solidarity project, with a donation collection built into the voting platform.

eligibilite.intro: Before you start, check that you meet the conditions of the 11th edition.
eligibilite.c1: Be part of the Manga’Queens community
eligibilite.c2: Be a full-figured woman of Cameroonian nationality
eligibilite.c4: Have a BMI between 25 and 30 kg/m²
eligibilite.c7: Be bilingual and fluent in your mother tongue
eligibilite.c8: Good physical presence, eloquence and good character
eligibilite.c10: Carry a project built around the theme of the edition
eligibilite.c11: Married or single, with or without children
eligibilite.c12: Be available throughout the whole journey
